run_TestCase_test_interoperability: run the TestCase enum test_interoperability method to execute a specific gRPC interop test case
create_Pipe_threadsafe_queue: create a thread-safe Pipe object to coordinate request and response streaming between client and server
test_large_unary_call: test a large unary gRPC call by sending a compressable payload and validating response size
test_full_duplex_streaming: test full duplex streaming by sending ping-pong requests and validating response payload sizes
test_custom_metadata_echo: test custom initial and trailing metadata echo by sending metadata and validating server response
